pages.text: The gem's face is a 16x16 grid, and the scroll's symbol shows through faintly. $(bold)Left-click$() carves a cell; $(bold)right-click$() smooths it back. Carve the whole symbol — no more, no less — and confirm.$(br2)A live preview shows exactly what your finished gem will look like.

Every carved cell costs one point of chisel durability, so grand symbols wear your tools faster. Better chisels last longer — and a netherite edge cuts so cleanly it wastes less of itself on every engraving.
A diamond chisel holds four times the edge of iron.
Netherite: sixteen times the durability, and every engraving costs one cell less.
